model: Exactly 0.2 percentage points of entry notional deducted once per completed round trip: net_pct = gross_price_pct - 0.2. No additional fee/slippage deductions.
risk: 0.5% maximum intended NET loss, therefore initial raw price stop is 0.3% below entry. Actual adverse opening gaps retained.
entry: Same 38 BTC + 11 SUI as v1; no entry or breakout parameter changes.
profit: Ordinary +0.5% gross => +0.3% net; +1% gross => +0.8% net. Breakout trail arms at +1% gross, distance0.5%.
old_reference: Prior regime-dependent policy rerun at these corrected costs: bearish +1% NET target, bullish +1% NET AND DI+ >50 to activate0.5% trail.
data: Only original frozen 15m source, frozen 1m/5m prices and frozen 5m gate observations. No fresh memory reads or classifiers.
validation: Both OHLC paths and common frame per entry; preserve original v1 evidence. No live configuration changes.
